name: Clock, Sunrise / Sunset
description: Today's sunrise, sunset, golden hour, and day length for a chosen lat/lon. The hero shows a sun-arc visualisation with the current position marked. Data from Open-Meteo (no key).

cell_options.name: location
cell_options.label: Place
cell_options.help: Search a city, or paste a 'lat, lon' pair ('-37.85, 144.94'), to set the location. The latitude / longitude that drive the weather data come from the picked result; the Place name below auto-fills with the city name (or the coordinates).

cell_options.name: label
cell_options.label: Place name
cell_options.help: Auto-filled from the place you pick; edit it to customise (for example 'Home' instead of 'Berlin').

cell_options.name: show_twilight
cell_options.label: Twilight
cell_options.help: Tints the civil, nautical and astronomical twilight bands beyond the horizon.
